what.text: This page follows refugees from Colombia living in Venezuela, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 14173 Colombian refugees in Venezuela, 17.8% of all refugees from Colombia.
Ecuador hosts the most Colombian refugees, followed by Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 1988 to 2025, with the ELN, EPL, FARC and M-19 among the opponents.
It records the conflict at war level in some of those years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 7 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 204259, at the end of 2013, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2007 to 2017.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Venezuela.
These are year-end totals for Venezuela only, reported to UNHCR.
